primary_anchor_zh: 彼此分开的三把收拢阳伞
story_reason_zh: 阳伞被取去检查布面，随后放回庭院墙边

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 一组大型阳伞在阳光庭院的浅色墙边，宽布边缘轻微摆动。
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 彼此分开的三把收拢阳伞占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 庭院管理员缓慢推动装有三把阳伞的支架穿过拱门离开画面；随后呈现空墙边和石质地面。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 庭院管理员缓慢推动装有三把阳伞的支架穿过拱门离开画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 庭院管理员缓慢将装有三把阳伞的支架推回浅色墙边
shot_design.main_action_zh: 庭院管理员缓慢将装有三把阳伞的支架推回浅色墙边
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 清楚呈现彼此分开的三把收拢阳伞；不要求复现精确排列。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed wide shot frames three large closed parasols, clearly separated from one another against a pale wall in a sunlit courtyard. Their broad fabric edges move slightly.

A fixed wide shot shows three large closed parasols, clearly separated from one another against a pale wall in a sunlit courtyard. A groundskeeper slowly rolls a stand holding all three closed parasols through the courtyard archway and out of frame. The fixed camera then holds on the empty pale wall and the stone courtyard floor. Tree shadows shift gently.

A fixed wide shot holds on the empty pale wall and the stone courtyard floor. A groundskeeper slowly rolls a stand holding three large closed parasols back into frame and stops it against the pale wall.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 庭院管理员缓慢推动装有三把阳伞的支架穿过拱门离开画面
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 庭院管理员缓慢将装有三把阳伞的支架推回浅色墙边
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
